chapter.verse: Pasian aw, ka dikna hong langsak in la, migilote tawh ka thu-ah hong panpih in; mi kheemte leh thutang lote kiang panin kei hong honkhia in!
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in kong belh Pasian na hi hi; bang hangin kei hong nilkhia na hi hiam? Galte’ sukcip manin bang hangin kapkap-in ka kidik hiam?
Na khuavak leh na thuman hong sawl khia in la, na mual siangtho leh na omna-ah kei hong paipih sakin, hong khasak in!
Tua ciangin Pasian biakna tau ahi zongin, ka lungdamna Pasian kiangah ahi zongin ka pia dinga, laiza khausai lasakna tawh nang kong phat ding hi, aw Pasian, ka Pasian aw.
Bang hangin khakunkun ka hi hiam, bang hangin lunghimawh ka hi hiam? Pasian sungah lametna nei ning; bang hang hiam cih leh kei hong huhpa ka Pasian ka phatkik na ding hi.
